Convert Video to MP3 Online

Extract audio from video as MP3. Free, no sign-up, your file stays on your device.

  • Free, no sign-up
  • Processed on your device
  • No watermark

About this tool

Extract the sound from a video and save it as MP3. It uses your browser's own ability to read audio, so common formats such as MP4, MOV, and WEBM are the safest. Very long videos need a lot of memory; use Chrome or Edge on a computer for large files.

How to use it

  1. Choose a file

    Drag a file into the box above or click to pick one from your device.

  2. Adjust the options

    Choose the format or quality, then press the process button.

  3. Download the result

    Save the files one by one or all at once in a ZIP.

When this tool is useful

Extract the sound from a video for meeting recordings, lectures, music, or interviews. Audio files are much smaller, so they are easy to store and send.

Tips and common mistakes

  • Choose MP3 for wide compatibility, WAV for uncompressed quality, or AAC to copy the original sound without conversion.
  • If the browser cannot read the video audio, try AAC or use the latest Chrome.
  • Long videos need more time and memory; use a computer when possible.

Related reading: MP3, AAC, and WAV: The Differences and How to Extract Audio from a Video

Frequently asked questions

How do I keep only part of the audio?
Fill in Start and End, for example 0:30 to 1:00. Leave End empty to use the rest of the audio. Trimming works for MP3 and WAV, not AAC.
Which video formats are supported?
Whatever your browser can read: usually MP4, MOV, WEBM, M4A, MP3, WAV, OGG. Formats such as MKV or AVI are often not supported.
How long does it take?
It depends on the length and your device. A 10-minute video usually finishes in a few seconds on a computer.
Is my file uploaded to a server?
No. The conversion runs in your browser, so the file stays on your device. Only program components (such as the PDF library) are downloaded from this site; for HEIC and MP3 one extra component is also loaded from jsDelivr. Your file is not sent along.
What is the file size limit?
Ubahin allows 200 MB per file, but the real limit depends on your device memory. Very large files can make the browser slow or stop.
Is it free? Do I need to sign up?
Free, with no account. There is no watermark on the results.
